page.overview:
Who is Ukkari?

Seaman Recruit Ukkari is a Marine who serves at the Shells Town Marine base.

Ukkari is a short man. He wears the standard Marine uniform: a white sleeveless shirt and hat.

Like all other Marines in Shells Town, Ukkari hated and feared Captain Morgan.

He lightly scratched Morgan's statue as he was raising it up. Morgan decided to kill him for the scratch, but before Morgan was able to do so, Luffy showed up on the roof and accidentally destroyed the statue.
